package store

import (
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestSelectedClosureProvisioningPhaseProfile(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("CCI_CLOSER_PHASE_PROFILE") != "1" {
		t.Fatal("profile invocation requires CCI_CLOSER_PHASE_PROFILE=1")
	}
	raw := os.Getenv("CCI_CLOSER_PROVISION_ROWS")
	if raw == "" {
		t.Skip("CI supplies the representative closer projection population")
	}
	population, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if os.Getenv("CCI_OLD_STORE_PROBE") == "" {
		t.Fatal("the native writer-budget profile requires CCI_OLD_STORE_PROBE")
	}
	for _, population := range []int{32, 10000} {
		t.Run("old-writer-"+strconv.Itoa(population), func(t *testing.T) {
			if elapsed := selectedClosureOldCloserWriter(t, population); elapsed >= 5*time.Second {
				t.Fatalf("native old-writer wait exceeds budget: rows=%d elapsed=%s", population, elapsed)
			}
		})
	}
	ctx := t.Context()
	st, _ := openStore(t)
	for i := len(closerMemberships) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		object := closerMemberships[i]
		if _, err := st.db.ExecContext(ctx, "DROP "+object.kind+" "+object.name); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := st.db.ExecContext(ctx, `WITH RECURSIVE history(n) AS (
 VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM history WHERE n < ?
 )
 INSERT INTO records(drive,lane,kind,at,text,re,topic,refs,source,hash)
 SELECT 'd','history','answer',n,'closer',1000000+n,'topic-'||n,'{"stacks":["a/x"],"targets":["api"]}','post','closer-'||n FROM history`, population); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fingerprint := st.SchemaFingerprint()
	t.Setenv("CCI_INDEX_PROFILE_SCOPE", "selected-250k")
	report, err := MaintainIndexes(ctx, st.HomeDir())
	if err != nil || len(report.Memberships) != len(closerMemberships) {
		t.Fatalf("new closer projection writer budget: records=%d report=%+v error=%v", population, report, err)
	}
	var keys, records int
	profileKeysStarted := time.Now()
	if err := st.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM record_closer_keys").Scan(&keys); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	profileKeysElapsed := time.Since(profileKeysStarted)
	profileRecordsStarted := time.Now()
	if err := st.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM records").Scan(&records); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	profileRecordsElapsed := time.Since(profileRecordsStarted)
	if keys != 4*population || records != population || st.SchemaFingerprint() != fingerprint {
		t.Fatalf("projection changed logical state/keys: keys=%d records=%d fingerprint=%s", keys, records, st.SchemaFingerprint())
	}
	observedKeys := int64(keys)
	observedRecords := int64(records)
	emitIndexMaintenanceProfile(indexMaintenanceProfile{Phase: "Observe", Object: "record_closer_keys", ElapsedNS: profileKeysElapsed.Nanoseconds(), Value: &observedKeys})
	emitIndexMaintenanceProfile(indexMaintenanceProfile{Phase: "Observe", Object: "records", ElapsedNS: profileRecordsElapsed.Nanoseconds(), Value: &observedRecords})
	emitIndexMaintenanceProfile(indexMaintenanceProfile{Phase: "Budget", Object: "maintenance", ElapsedNS: report.Elapsed.Nanoseconds()})
	if report.Elapsed >= 5*time.Second {
		t.Fatalf("new closer projection writer budget: records=%d report=%+v error=%v", population, report, err)
	}
	t.Logf("closer_projection_records=%d keys=%d elapsed=%s writer_budget=%s before=%+v after=%+v", records, keys, report.Elapsed, 5*time.Second, report.Before, report.After)
}
